supersedes_note: v3.2.4.6 supersedes v3.2.4.5 due to bytecode-cache self-test break and missing license file. Underlying architectural content is unchanged from v3.2.4.5; current_version reflects the patch artifact, not the post-apply baseline tag.
current_post_apply_stable_report_hash_no: Computed by the customer after apply via running scripts/bootstrap-acceptance.sh on the post-apply tree. Recorded into M1-COMPLETION-CRITERIA.md. Becomes immutable on tag v3.2.4.5-bootstrap-baseline only after the customer's clean-clone reproduction succeeds.
patch_tree_hash_note: Computed by scripts/check_patch_self_test.py over the patch contents. Echoed back from PATCH-MANIFEST.json's patch_tree_hash field at apply time.
_note_count_arithmetic: covered (17) + partial (1: INV-001) + deferred (14) = 32. INV-006 is COVERED with runtime hash chain at M5. INV-001 is the only PARTIAL entry. The 14 deferred entries match exactly the deferred_invariants list above.

amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.ADR-0042: Key compromise transition rewritten to remove the unsafe 'new + old' pattern. Compromised keys are revoked permanently and never re-appear in a signing chain. New replacement key + uncompromised counterpart + Root attestation pattern preserves separation-of-duties without trusting the dead key.
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.ADR-0043: Status changed from PROPOSED to PROPOSED-STRATEGIC-PIVOT. Stale '53+3=56' arithmetic removed; defers to VERSION_METADATA.json. Founder sign-off tracked as M1-DECISION-001.
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.update_bundle_signed.schema.json: Added contains/minContains/maxContains constraint that requires exactly one signature from each of release-engineer + security-officer.
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.update_promotion_decision.schema.json: Added Tier-3 if/then enforcement of role composition (>=2 maintainers + >=1 security-officer) plus tier-specific minimum soak duration (T1=86400s, T2=172800s, T3=604800s).
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.telemetry_envelope.schema.json: Added allOf+if/then constraints that bind payload_kind to payload shape ($defs.StatusPayload, $defs.HealthPayload, $defs.FailureSignaturePayload, $defs.NonePayload).
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.OWNERS.yaml: Added _note_placeholders field that explicitly flags the placeholder handles MUST be replaced with real GitHub handles before any production code PR.
amendments_in_v3_2_4_5_vs_v3_2_4_4_inher.scripts/jsonschema_minimal.py: Extended to support contains/minContains/maxContains constructs needed by the tightened schemas above.

policy.no_approximate_counts_note: Counts in this file and downstream documents are exact integers. The release-metadata-consistency check rejects any document containing approximation words in count contexts.
policy.no_unverified_test_count_claims_note: Documents in this patch do NOT claim 'all 35 PASS' or 'all 55 PASS' unless accompanied by ops/compliance/v3.2.4.6-shiptime-transcript.txt for ship-time-tested artifacts, or ops/compliance/v3.2.4.5-clean-rerun-transcript.txt for post-apply gates. The numbers above are structural expectations, not claimed results.
policy.manifest_is_source_of_truth_for_apply_no: scripts/apply_v3_2_4_6.py reads PATCH-MANIFEST.json's apply_mode field for every file; it does not maintain a separate hard-coded internal-file list.
